title: Conda channel priority relaxed
description: .condarc declares a `channel_priority` value that lets a lower channel win on version. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `channel_priority` value that lets a lower channel win on version.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a `channel_priority` value that lets a lower channel win on version.
limitation: It matches a `channel_priority` value that lets a lower channel win on version in the parsed .condarc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
